visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a 2D animation of a stylized orange tabby cat character (Mochi Dad) dancing against a pale pink and white background. The cat has its eyes closed and is rhythmically swinging its paws and body from side to side in a playful, high-energy dance. (2) The scene abruptly cuts to the cat character lying flat on its back, looking exhausted or annoyed with narrow, slightly crossed eyes. It makes small, weak gestures with its paws as if giving up, while variety-show style text appears over its torso. (3) The sequence returns to the first phase, showing the cat dancing enthusiastically again with its eyes closed, repeating the rhythmic movement perfectly. (4) The visual cycles back once more to the exhausted state, creating a rhythmic loop of contrasting moods between high-energy activity and comical fatigue.
